fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' empowers her crossblade for the next 4 seconds, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and causing her basic attacks to bounce to additional surrounding enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to them. If the triggering attack {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}, the bounces will do so as well for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Sivir|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage. ''Ricochet'' deals 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} and executes them if they would be left below {{sti|{{as|15 health}}}}.
fields.description2: Bounces occur only up to 8 times and can target each enemy up to one additional time per empowered attack. They prioritize the nearest new target, then the nearest target if no new targets are available.
fields.description3: ''Ricochet {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sivir's''' basic attack timer if it was {{tt|not already active|See notes}}. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be bounced to.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
